sections.title: Dell Medical School and UT Austin Health Innovation
sections.description: Dell Medical School (University of Texas at Austin) — founded 2016, the newest top-50 research university medical school in the US.

blocks.heading: Population health for Austin's rapidly growing population
paragraphs: ML for the population health programs serving Central Texas's extraordinary growth — Travis County added 300,000+ residents in the decade 2010–2020, and the healthcare infrastructure serving this new population requires AI that can handle demographic profiles that are unusually young, diverse, and health-technology-engaged compared to national averages.

blocks.heading: Social determinants and community health AI
paragraphs: ML for the social determinants of health programs that Dell Medical School has built as a core part of its community health mission — Austin's growing unhoused population, the economic displacement of longtime Austin residents by rapid cost-of-living increases, and the specific health challenges of Austin's diverse immigrant communities all create community health AI demand that Dell Medical's founding mission explicitly addresses.

blocks.heading: Clinical research analytics
paragraphs: ML for Dell Medical School's growing clinical research portfolio — the school is rapidly building research programs in musculoskeletal care, population health, maternal-fetal medicine, and cancer that create clinical trial analytics and biomarker discovery AI demand.

sections.title: Ascension Texas Clinical AI
sections.description: Ascension Texas (Austin HQ) operates Seton Medical Center, Dell Seton, St. David's (through partnership), and other Central Texas facilities.

blocks.heading: Texas Medicaid analytics for Austin's large Medicaid population
paragraphs: ML for the managed care organizations serving Austin's large Texas Medicaid population — STAR program analytics, care gap identification, and chronic disease management for the Texas HHSC-regulated Medicaid managed care programs that Ascension participates in.

blocks.heading: Maternal-fetal medicine analytics
paragraphs: ML for Ascension's large obstetrics program — Austin's extraordinary population growth has created one of the US's highest birth rates among major metros, making maternal care analytics a commercially significant healthcare AI opportunity.

blocks.heading: HIPAA-compliant clinical workflow AI
paragraphs: Standard clinical prediction and workflow automation for Ascension's Central Texas hospital network.

sections.title: Digital Health and Telemedicine Startups
sections.description: Austin's health technology startup community — building the next generation of digital health products.

blocks.heading: Virtual care platform analytics
paragraphs: ML for the telemedicine and virtual care startups building platforms in Austin — patient engagement prediction, clinical outcome measurement, and the operational analytics for virtual care organizations competing in Austin's health-tech-forward market.

blocks.heading: Mental health technology AI
paragraphs: ML for the growing Austin mental health technology community — Texas has significant mental health care access challenges, and Austin's technology community has spawned a growing cluster of digital mental health companies building AI-enhanced behavioral health products.

blocks.heading: Health and wellness consumer AI
paragraphs: ML for the consumer health apps and wellness technology companies headquartered or founded in Austin — nutrition, fitness, sleep, and chronic condition management AI for the consumer health companies that Austin's active lifestyle culture and technology entrepreneurship ecosystem has produced.

sections.title: Baylor Scott & White Central Texas Network
sections.description: BSW's Round Rock hospital and growing Central Texas network.

blocks.heading: Central Texas community health analytics
paragraphs: Population health ML for the suburban Austin communities that BSW's Round Rock and other Central Texas facilities serve — the specific health demographics of Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Georgetown, and the other fast-growing Austin suburbs require AI calibrated to young, high-income, tech-worker-concentrated communities.

blocks.heading: Texas Health Information Exchange integration
paragraphs: ML leveraging the Texas Health Services Authority's health information exchange data for more complete patient clinical picture across the Austin multi-health-system environment.

sections.title: Texas healthcare AI regulatory context

blocks.heading: Texas Medical Board
paragraphs: Clinical AI in Texas must align with Texas Medical Board regulations on clinical decision support.

blocks.heading: Texas Health Privacy Act
paragraphs: Texas's health information privacy law creates consumer health data protections that apply to Austin's digital health startup community.
